finalText:
Found it. `src/core/settings.js` had `maxRetries: retries` — `retries` was never defined, it should have read from `env.retries`. That threw and killed the link stage every time.

Fixed it to `maxRetries: env.retries || 3`, and the build now finishes clean: exit 0, "3 warnings, 0 errors."

The 3 warnings left are just noise you can look at later — a deprecated `crypto.createCipher` call, an unused export, and a circular import — none of them were breaking anything.
